messages.content: Find the best character to use against a dragon in DragonSlayer game.

function.name: game_find_best_weapon
function.description: Finds the best weapon in the inventory to use against a particular enemy type based on the player's level and the enemy's strength and weaknesses. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

enemy_type.description: The type of enemy the player is facing.

inventory.description: List of weapons currently in player's inventory.

message.content:
I can help you pick the best **weapon** to use against a dragon, which usually determines which character class or build will be most effective.  
To do that I’ll need a bit more information:

1. **Your current player level** (or the level of the character you plan to use).  
2. **The weapons you currently have in your inventory** (if you have any special items or upgrades).

Once I have those details, I can run the best‑weapon algorithm and tell you which weapon—and consequently which character build—will give you the biggest advantage against a dragon.
